notes: Transforming into princesses and roleplaying with no quests, contest or score is Morph Roleplay exactly: a fixed pre-built place where all the personalization happens on the avatar and none of it on property. I substituted interior-single for the preset's settlement-static because the answers make the castle interior the whole map rather than a town, and that shape is the one that says there is no exterior to generate and no transition to link — which is why this routes P0 and not the P3 an enterable castle would otherwise carry. I kept the preset's social hub as the great hall and its scenic backdrops for roleplay scenes, dropped landmark-focal since an interior has no cross-map sightline to navigate by, and added path-street for the corridors linking the rooms. With no user to ask I picked the main rooms a castle is expected to have — hall, throne room, bedchambers — and read transformation as an avatar morph needing no dedicated structure beyond those rooms.
